topic: Review of recent project work hours
summary_markdown:
The conversation involved the submission of a detailed log summarizing work performed across multiple projects and dates. The logged time includes: 16 hours on corporate web and AllUnite; 8 hours on the Allunite project (May 15 - May 26); 42 hours on the Allunite project for chart migration, bug fixes, and optimization (June 10 - June 24); and additional time logged in July/August related to image management, airport page development (routes, components, sunkey diagram), and general work.

The total billed amounts mentioned are $1,320.00 for a period ending July 22, 2022, and $200.00 for a period starting August 2, 2022.
